{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= GUI

|descr= Show or hide given markers using fade effect.

|s1= [action, markers] call [[BIS_fnc_showMarkers]]

|p1= action: [[String]] - can be "show" or "hide". Any other value will be ignored.

|p2= markers: [[Array]] of [[String]]s - markers to show/hide

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>["hide", ["respawn_west", "respawn_east"]] call BIS_fnc_showMarkers;</sqf>

|seealso= [[:Category:Command Group: Markers|Markers command group]]
}}
